Maya Datt: Quick weekly capacity snapshot for KiteLabs — posting the highlights.
Maya Datt: GPU hours last 7d: 4,320 (-6% W/W). Pool saturation: 78% peak, several 2–5 min spikes around 13:00–14:30 UTC. Avg queue depth: 12 (p95 spike to 24). Latency p95 (text-gen): 420ms (target 350ms). Error rate: 0.6% model failures (largely OOMs on long-context requests). Spend: $9,400 (≈12% over committed hours).
Samir Hossain: Thanks — can you break that by pool? which model variants are causing OOMs?
Maya Datt: pool breakdown: kite-prod-gpu (64% hours, p95 queue 18), kite-batch-1 (22%), kite-canary (14%). OOMs limited to model variant `redwood-llama-70b-q4` under 32k context. Most errors from calls with huge prompts + embeddings at once.
CapacityBot: ALERT: queue_depth>10 on pool kite-prod-gpu (2025-11-12T13:14:02Z). Recent 10m avg: 13.
Arjun Patel: Suggest temporary bump: set min_replicas kite-prod-gpu -> 5 for 13:00–15:00 UTC window, and add a short-lived autoscale policy to target gpu_utilization 65%.
Arjun Patel: Example patch:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 5
  max_replicas: 20
  scale_policy:
    - metric: gpu_utilization
      target: 65
```
Jess Rivera: I'll raise CS-4321 to track the canary bump + cost impact and ping finance about the overage. Also want to check onboarding: did we advise KiteLabs to enable request size limits? That would reduce OOM risk.
Maya Datt: Good call. I'll schedule the canary bump tonight at 02:00 UTC and add a temporary request-size limiter rule (2x median prompt length). Also adding a log filter to capture full stacks for those OOMs.
Samir Hossain: For longer term — recommend we run a quantization/variant tuning session with KiteLabs to move heavy workload off 70b when not needed. Could save ~18% GPU hours.
Jess Rivera: Noted — I'll propose that in renewal prep. Action items: (1) Maya: schedule and execute canary bump (02:00 UTC) (2) Jess: open CS-4321, notify finance (3) Arjun: patch autoscaler and monitor 2h post-change (4) Samir: draft tuning plan and cost estimate.
Maya Datt: Confirmed. Will post results and updated metrics in this thread after bump. :white_check_mark:
CapacityBot: NOTE: scheduled job "kite-canary-bump" created (runs 2025-11-13T02:00:00Z).
